chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fazzal, from Yunus ibn Yaqub, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): 'From where should I enter Makkah, as I have come from Al-Madina?' He said: 'Enter from the upper part of Makkah. And when you exit intending Al-Madina, then exit from the lower part of Makkah.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended route for entering and exiting Makkah when traveling from Al-Madina according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* outlines the customary practice (*'urf*) of entering Makkah from the north (Bab al-Nabi or 'Upper Gate') and exiting from the south (Bab al-'Amud or 'Lower Gate'), a tradition rooted in the Prophet's and Imams' habits. It highlights the importance of following established prophetic routes during pilgrimage, reflecting the Shia emphasis on adhering to the practical teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt in ritual observance.
